geo_basis: country named in the report (Angola); pin at Luanda
title: NETSCOUT report lists 100 DDoS attacks on Angola in first half of 2026, including telecom and oil and gas
date_note: NETSCOUT's page shows no publication day; the earliest dated page read is Expansão's article of 25 November 2026.
summary: NETSCOUT's threat report page for Angola lists 100 DDoS attacks between January and June 2026. The page counts six attacks on oil and gas well drilling, and telecommunications carriers were also targeted. The page gives a maximum of eight attack vectors in a single attack.
plain: NETSCOUT's report counts 100 attacks in the first half of 2026 that tried to knock Angolan services offline, including attacks on telecom carriers and oil and gas drilling.
exec: NETSCOUT's report counts 100 DDoS attacks on Angola in the first half of 2026, hitting telecom carriers and oil and gas.

evidence.quote: 100 ataques cibernéticos de indisponibilidade de serviço

key_findings: 100 DDoS attacks on Angola from January to June 2026.
Six attacks on oil and gas well drilling; telecommunications carriers also targeted.
At most eight attack vectors in a single attack.

validation.note: NETSCOUT's own country page (primary, undated) and Expansão (independent publisher) both give 100 attacks.

review.note: Compared 100 attacks Jan-Jun 2026, six oil/gas drilling, telecom, max 8 vectors against NETSCOUT page and Expansao; NETSCOUT page undated
